parsed.explanation: Tier-1 state-imposed exposures dominate: a binary document regime with X markers eliminated, reports of passports blocked/confiscated and travellers stranded, and a Feb 2025 cable directing officers to refuse cases where sex is doubted and to weigh lifetime fraud ineligibility for marker discrepancy; a trans-athlete entry ban; allied governments issuing advisories after detentions of foreign nationals. Facilities access is barred by birth sex across many states, with trespass statutes and a documented arrest. Custody (prison and immigration) carries documented conversion-style practices and abuse. Counterterrorism rhetoric frames pro-trans ideology as a target. Offsets: no criminalisation of trans identity, no national sodomy law, a gender-identity hate-crime statute, 22 states plus the capital with anti-discrimination law, contested policy in courts, and no documented trans-specific violence rate.
